description: Smart Meters is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Energy Security and Net Zero. Quarterly statistics on the roll-out of smart meters in Great Britain, covering meters operating and meters installed. Official Statistics. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Energy Security and Net Zero. It offers 53 resource(s) in .XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
